configurations.sdk-matching-benchmark/00-go-compose.yml:
name: cadence-sdk-benchmark
services:
  frontend:
    cpus: 1
    cpuset: 2,3
    depends_on:
      history:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      CADENCE_AUTO_SETUP: "false"
      DB: mysql
      DYNAMIC_CONFIG_FILE_PATH: dynamicconfig/development.yaml
      MYSQL_PWD: root
      MYSQL_SEEDS: mysql
      MYSQL_USER: root
      PRIMARY_FRONTEND_SERVICE: frontend
      RINGPOP_SEEDS: frontend:7933,history:7934,matching:7935,worker:7939
      SERVICES: frontend
    image: cadence-go:ci
    mem_limit: "1468006400"
    memswap_limit: "1468006400"
    networks:
      default: null
    pids_limit: 2048
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 7933
        published: "7933"
        protocol: tcp
      - mode: ingress
        target: 7833
        published: "7833"
        protocol: tcp
  history:
    cpus: 1
    cpuset: 2,3
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      CADENCE_AUTO_SETUP: "true"
      DB: mysql
      DYNAMIC_CONFIG_FILE_PATH: dynamicconfig/development.yaml
      MYSQL_PWD: root
      MYSQL_SEEDS: mysql
      MYSQL_USER: root
      PRIMARY_FRONTEND_SERVICE: frontend
      RINGPOP_SEEDS: frontend:7933,history:7934,matching:7935,worker:7939
      SERVICES: history
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - bash
        - -c
        - echo > /dev/tcp/$$(hostname -i)/7934
      interval: 5s
      retries: 60
    image: cadence-go:ci
    mem_limit: "1468006400"
    memswap_limit: "1468006400"
    networks:
      default: null
    pids_limit: 2048
  matching:
    cpus: 1
    cpuset: 2,3
    depends_on:
      history:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      CADENCE_AUTO_SETUP: "false"
      DB: mysql
      DYNAMIC_CONFIG_FILE_PATH: dynamicconfig/development.yaml
      MYSQL_PWD: root
      MYSQL_SEEDS: mysql
      MYSQL_USER: root
      PRIMARY_FRONTEND_SERVICE: frontend
      RINGPOP_SEEDS: frontend:7933,history:7934,matching:7935,worker:7939
      SERVICES: matching
    image: cadence-go:ci
    mem_limit: "1468006400"
    memswap_limit: "1468006400"
    networks:
      default: null
    pids_limit: 2048
  mysql:
    cpus: 1.5
    cpuset: 2,3
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mysqladmin
        - ping
        - -proot
        - -h
        - 127.0.0.1
      interval: 5s
      retries: 40
    image: mysql:8.0
    mem_limit: "1887436800"
    memswap_limit: "1887436800"
    networks:
      default: null
    pids_limit: 2048
  worker:
    cpus: 1
    cpuset: 2,3
    depends_on:
      history:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      CADENCE_AUTO_SETUP: "false"
      DB: mysql
      DYNAMIC_CONFIG_FILE_PATH: dynamicconfig/development.yaml
      MYSQL_PWD: root
      MYSQL_SEEDS: mysql
      MYSQL_USER: root
      PRIMARY_FRONTEND_SERVICE: frontend
      RINGPOP_SEEDS: frontend:7933,history:7934,matching:7935,worker:7939
      SERVICES: worker
    image: cadence-go:ci
    mem_limit: "1468006400"
    memswap_limit: "1468006400"
    networks:
      default: null
    pids_limit: 2048

    memswap_limit: "1468006400"

name: cadence-sdk-benchmark
services:
  frontend:
    cpus: 1
    cpuset: 2,3
    depends_on:
      history:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      CADENCE_AUTO_SETUP: "false"
      DB: mysql
      DYNAMIC_CONFIG_FILE_PATH: dynamicconfig/development.yaml
      MYSQL_PWD: root
      MYSQL_SEEDS: mysql
      MYSQL_USER: root
      PRIMARY_FRONTEND_SERVICE: frontend
      RINGPOP_SEEDS: frontend:7933,history:7934,matching:7935,worker:7939
      SERVICES: frontend
    image: cadence-go:ci
    mem_limit: "1468006400"
    memswap_limit: "1468006400"
    networks:
      default: null
    pids_limit: 2048
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 7933
        published: "7933"
        protocol: tcp
      - mode: ingress
        target: 7833
        published: "7833"
        protocol: tcp
  history:
    cpus: 1
    cpuset: 2,3
    depends_on:
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true

      DB: mysql
      DYNAMIC_CONFIG_FILE_PATH: dynamicconfig/development.yaml
      MYSQL_PWD: root
      MYSQL_SEEDS: mysql
      MYSQL_USER: root
      PRIMARY_FRONTEND_SERVICE: frontend
      RINGPOP_SEEDS: frontend:7933,history:7934,matching:7935,worker:7939
      SERVICES: history
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - bash
        - -c
        - echo > /dev/tcp/$$(hostname -i)/7934
      interval: 5s
      retries: 60
    image: cadence-go:ci
    mem_limit: "1468006400"
    memswap_limit: "1468006400"
    networks:
      default: null
    pids_limit: 2048
  matching:
    cpus: 1
    cpuset: 2,3
    depends_on:
      history:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      CADENCE_AUTO_SETUP: "false"
      DB: mysql
      DYNAMIC_CONFIG_FILE_PATH: dynamicconfig/development.yaml
      MYSQL_PWD: root
      MYSQL_SEEDS: mysql
      MYSQL_USER: root
      PRIMARY_FRONTEND_SERVICE: frontend
      RINGPOP_SEEDS: frontend:7933,history:7934,matching:7935,worker:7939
      SERVICES: matching
    image: cadence-go:ci
    mem_limit: "1468006400"
    memswap_limit: "1468006400"
    networks:
      default: null
    pids_limit: 2048
  mysql:
    cpus: 1.5
    cpuset: 2,3
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mysqladmin
        - ping
        - -proot
        - -h
        - 127.0.0.1
      interval: 5s
      retries: 40
    image: mysql:8.0
    mem_limit: "1887436800"
    memswap_limit: "1887436800"
    networks:
      default: null
    pids_limit: 2048
  worker:
    cpus: 1
    cpuset: 2,3
    depends_on:
      history:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      CADENCE_AUTO_SETUP: "false"
      DB: mysql
      DYNAMIC_CONFIG_FILE_PATH: dynamicconfig/development.yaml
      MYSQL_PWD: root
      MYSQL_SEEDS: mysql
      MYSQL_USER: root
      PRIMARY_FRONTEND_SERVICE: frontend
      RINGPOP_SEEDS: frontend:7933,history:7934,matching:7935,worker:7939
      SERVICES: worker
    image: cadence-go:ci
    mem_limit: "1468006400"
